# LetsRandomize.org

> Browser-based list randomizers, random order tools, team generators, pickers, and number tools for everyday decisions.

LetsRandomize provides browser-based tools for randomizing lists, putting names in random order, creating teams, picking from a list, generating numbers, and running classroom or meeting activities. Core random generator tools use the Web Crypto API (`crypto.getRandomValues`) when available, with a Math.random fallback for older browsers. List and team shuffling tools use a Fisher-Yates shuffle through the shared randomization engine.

User-entered lists, names, and generated results are processed in the browser for the current session. Some tools may store history or preferences in localStorage. Standard hosting, advertising, analytics, or CDN systems may still collect technical request data as described in the privacy policy.

These tools are intended for everyday randomization and learning. They are not a substitute for certified randomness, legal/compliance-grade drawings, gambling systems, or independently audited selection processes.

## Tools

- [List Randomizer](https://letsrandomize.org/tools/list-randomizer/): Shuffle names, tasks, entries, or any list into random order; pick N items and handle duplicates
- [Random Team Generator](https://letsrandomize.org/tools/random-team-generator/): Split players, students, or participants into even random teams by team count or people per team
- [Spin the Wheel](https://letsrandomize.org/tools/spin-the-wheel/): Animated random picker wheel
- [Random Name Generator](https://letsrandomize.org/tools/random-name-generator/): Generate random first and last names
- [Random Number Generator](https://letsrandomize.org/tools/random-number-generator/): Generate random numbers in any range with multiple modes
- [Random Password Generator](https://letsrandomize.org/tools/random-password-generator/): Create strong passwords with customizable rules

## Decision and List Tools

- [Decision Tools](https://letsrandomize.org/decision-tools/): Hub for list shuffles, team splits, wheels, drawings, dice, cards, and quick choices
- [How to Randomize a List](https://letsrandomize.org/guides/how-to-randomize-a-list/): Clean and shuffle names from a class, meeting, spreadsheet, or CSV without losing items
- [Random Order Generator](https://letsrandomize.org/guides/random-order-generator/): Shuffle names, tasks, speakers, chores, raffles, or classroom turns and copy the result
- [Random Picker vs List Randomizer](https://letsrandomize.org/guides/random-picker-vs-list-randomizer/): Choose between one random pick, a full copied order, a wheel draw, or random teams
- [Random Name Order Generator](https://letsrandomize.org/guides/random-name-order-generator/): Put existing names in random order for turns, presentations, chores, or meetings
- [List Shuffler vs List Randomizer](https://letsrandomize.org/guides/list-shuffler-vs-list-randomizer/): Choose between a full list shuffle, a picker, or a team generator
- [Fair Random Selection Methods](https://letsrandomize.org/guides/fair-random-selection-methods/): Run a clearer casual random draw, document the result, and understand selection limits
- [How to Create Balanced Teams](https://letsrandomize.org/guides/how-to-create-balanced-teams/): Pick a random, seeded, or skill-balanced team method
- [Random Team Generator for Classroom](https://letsrandomize.org/guides/random-team-generator-for-classroom/): Create classroom groups while handling absent students, repeat pairings, and constraints

## Games

- [Reaction Time Test](https://letsrandomize.org/tools/reaction-time-test/): Measure visual reaction time in milliseconds
- [CPS Test](https://letsrandomize.org/tools/cps-test/): Click speed test (clicks per second)
- [Typing Speed Test](https://letsrandomize.org/tools/typing-speed-test/): Measure WPM typing speed
- [Memory Test](https://letsrandomize.org/tools/memory-test/): Test short-term visual memory
- [Reaction Time Scores](https://letsrandomize.org/guides/reaction-time-scores/): Explain good reaction time scores, 170ms, device latency, and test limits
- [Chimp Test Scores](https://letsrandomize.org/guides/chimp-test-scores/): Explain chimp test scores, visual memory, practice effects, and non-IQ limits

- [Terms of Use](https://letsrandomize.org/terms/): Randomness limitations and appropriate use
